title: Introducing Spaces in Muse
format_note: On-camera designer introduces one feature, with phone screen captures cut between presenter segments; mascot title card opens, app-store end card closes.
one_thing: You can build your own spaces in Muse just by chatting, and rearrange the whole app around them.

transcript.voice_style: Warm first-person designer, conversational, 'let me show you one of mine'; the VO runs over the screen captures.
transcript.script_shape: Greeting, claim (a space is built by chatting), personal example (Jolly Mall), second claim (customisable navigation), weekday/weekend example, thanks and invitation to build.

structure.frame0: Mascot (cream plush character) stands left, 'Introducing Spaces' and muse.ai right on white, Meta logo bottom left; poster-complete from t=0 (f0001.jpg), blue Muse wordmark appears by t=2s (f0002.jpg).
structure.first_3s: Mascot walks in from the left edge within 0.7s (window-01-0.126s.jpg) over an already-set title; wordmark fades in; mascot waves at about 3.4-4.4s (window-04-3.254s.jpg).

beats.what: Mascot title card: 'Introducing Spaces', mascot walks in and waves.
Presenter on camera with name lower third; introduces himself and Spaces.
Phone chat creates Family Dashboard, drawer opens, tap into dashboard, scroll events, lunchbox checklist, carpool.
Jolly Mall space: saturated blue 90s catalogue feed, scroll, tap mug item for detail and BUY NOW.
Drawer reopens; Jolly Mall row dragged up into the Tabs section.
Chat: 'Weekend mode please', typing, reply, tab bar changes to chat, feed, dashboard, memory bank, trip planner.
Presenter closing: 'We're really excited to see what you build.'
Fade through black to Muse app icon, store badges, Meta logo.

hero_moment.what: Hard cut from the white sidebar to the full-bleed blue Jolly Mall catalogue feed; the only saturated screen in a pale film (f0017.jpg).

ending.cta_text: Muse. Get it on Google Play. Download on the App Store.
ending.what: Black card, app icon fades up from t=86.0s, store badges then Meta logo; icon, name and badges centred, held to the end.

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: Long phone shots (19.3s longest, 21% of runtime) carry the demo with in-shot scrolling and drawer slides; cuts are rare and fall at topic changes, with flicker pairs at 32.45/32.57 and 64.98/65.06/65.48. No burst.

look.accent_use: One saturated royal-blue screen (Jolly Mall) and the blue Muse wordmark; everything else stays pale, so the blue reads as the personalised space.

good.observation: Frame 0 is a finished poster: mascot, two-word title, URL and brand mark all present, so the film is legible with no build-up.
The demo is a single user story told in chat: ask, see the result, ask again. Each phone shot answers the sentence the presenter is saying.
One saturated screen in a pale film: the royal-blue Jolly Mall feed is the unmistakable hero, and it also shows the personalisation claim.
Real product UI at phone-readable size: 14-18px chat and drawer text on 1280px frames stays legible because the phone is punched in.
Few cuts for 90s, each at a topic change; long takes (19.3s longest) let the scroll and drawer motion carry attention.
The ending reuses the opening's brand mark and gives store badges on black, held about 4s.

weak.observation: The film is slow to show the product: first phone screen at 13.14s, 14% into the runtime, after 8.7s of presenter talk.
Loudness is well under social targets and cuts are unrelated to the beat.
Presenter segments are static medium shots with a static lower third; the energy sits only in the phone segments.
Fast taps and drag are shown as a faint grey circle that is easy to miss at 2s sampling.

rule_candidates.rule: Open on a complete title card (subject, two-word title, URL, brand mark) and let a character or object animate in over it within 0.7s; do not build the title.
When the film has one personalised hero screen, make it the only saturated colour field in a pale film, and hard-cut to it at about one third of runtime.
rule_candidates.evidence: Jolly Mall blue at t=32.5s, share 0.36; f0017.jpg

rule_candidates.rule: A feature explainer with an on-camera presenter can run median shot 4.5s and 10 cuts a minute if the phone shots hold up to 19s with in-shot motion.
Show product UI by punching the phone in about 2x on chat and drawer rows so text is at least 14px on a 720p frame, then pull back to the full device for a reveal.
A film with no energetic burst can still hold attention: change comes from one cause on screen per cut, with zero bursts across 90s.
End on black with the icon fading up over about 0.4s after a fade-through-black from the last shot, then hold icon, name, badges 3.9s.
Show taps as a visible ripple at least 60px wide on a 1280px frame and hold for 0.3s so a viewer can follow the action between cuts.

rule_candidates.rule: Mix at -14 LUFS for social; this film at -19 LUFS with -1.8 dBTP is quieter than the target and is the failure to avoid.
